interactions.text:
Seller: Are you looking at any alternatives for procedure packs right now?
Buyer (Materials Manager): No. We're not looking at other suppliers right now. NorthStar has been fine for us.
Seller: It sounds like there isn't a reason to evaluate alternatives right now. What, if anything, would have to change for that to become worthwhile?
Buyer (Materials Manager): If our supplier raises pricing by more than 10% when our agreement renews, we'd evaluate other options.

Seller: Is the team evaluating any alternatives for fastening components at the moment?
Buyer (Purchasing Lead): No. We're under a long-term agreement and it's working.
Seller: What, if anything, would have to change for looking at another option to become worthwhile?
Buyer (Purchasing Lead): Honestly, I can't think of anything. Nothing on the horizon would change that.

Seller: Are you currently looking at alternatives?
Buyer (Director of Supply Chain): Yes. We opened a formal supplier review last month and are comparing three vendors.
Buyer (Director of Supply Chain): If our current supplier can't hold pricing, we'd move even faster on this.
